[[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] works well in those tough Dark Side space decks that always seem to pop up in every tournament. He's a tough customer weighing in at 3 power and 3 ability! His deploy is 3, which isn't cheap.... unless you have two Imperial starships on the table, then he is just a mere 1 Force to deploy anywhere! Another wonderful aspect of this versitile card is [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is both a warrior and a pilot, so no matter what type of deck you play him in he is a formitable enemy for those pesky Rebels.

Combos:

[[Admiral Motti]] + [[Lone Pilot]] - This is a great combo to use in your space decks. This simply allows you to add to battle destiny if [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a system. So put him on [[Black 2]] or a [[TIE Avenger]] and sit back and smile as you opponent initiates a battle. You drop down [[Lone Pilot]] and whammo, you get 2 battle destiny.....then hope you get a lucky draw!

[[Admiral Motti]] + [[Vader's Eye]] + [[Lone Warrior]] - If you choose to deploy [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] to a site, use these two Lost Interrupts to insure you don't get squashed by the Rebellion. If [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a site these two interrupt will allow you to draw 2 battle destiny, to make sure you put some fear into the hearts of the those pesky Rebels.
|combos=* [[Admiral Motti]] + [[Lone Pilot]] Add two battle destiny if [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a system.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Admiral%20Motti</ref>
* [[Admiral Motti]] + [[Vader's Eye]] + [[Lone Warrior]] Add two battle destiny if [[Admiral Motti{{!}}Motti]] is defending a battle alone at a site.
